# HealthiClick Bot – AI Diet Chat Application

**HealthiClick Bot** is a full-stack AI-powered chat application that provides personalized diet guidance. Users can log in with Google and ask diet-related questions, receiving answers generated by a large language model (Google Gemini) that references a curated database of 50 FAQs.

## Features
- 🟢 Google Authentication via Clerk  
- 🟢 AI-powered responses with FAQ references  
- 🟢 Conversation history for seamless chat experience  
- 🟢 Modern, responsive UI with React and Tailwind CSS  
- 🟢 FAQ database with ready-made diet Q&A  

## How It Works
1. **User Interaction**: Users ask diet-related questions via a chat interface.  
2. **AI Processing**: Questions are sent to the backend where Google Gemini AI generates context-aware answers.  
3. **FAQ Reference**: Answers include references to the preloaded FAQ database for reliability.  
4. **Response Delivery**: Users receive AI-generated answers with relevant references in real-time.
